reader_summary.headline: A crisis is an opportunity to change one's culture, to model scenarios and set up a crisis plan/process.
reader_summary.overview: A crisis is an opportunity to change one's culture, to model scenarios and set up a crisis plan/process, to become a better company. But it's also a bit like therapy, from the act of asking probing questions to get at the facts ... to dealing with emotions and conflicting agendas.

key_points.text: In this hallway-style conversation with a16z's Margit Wennmachers and Kim Milosevich -- who previously shared the why, how.
Because it's something that seems so obvious to those who are on the inside (but even then it's really not!).
Can someone inside a company "call it" early and prevent a crisis from becoming a bigger deal?
